name: Notion AI Meeting Notes
desc: Notion block that transcribes and summarizes your meetings.
desc_zh: 自动转录并总结会议内容的 Notion 区块
solves: Nobody wants to be the note-taker. The block captures the conversation and writes the summary while you stay in the discussion.
solves_zh: 没人愿意当记录员。这个区块把讨论记下来并整理成总结，你可以专心开会。
best_for: A call starts in five minutes and the doc for it is still empty.
best_for_zh: 五分钟后开会，会议文档还是一片空白。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.notion.com/releases/page/9）。 Launched with Notion 2.51; notes could be added automatically to Notion Calendar events. Speaker labels arrived 2026-07-01, consent controls 2026-03-12, and Custom Agents can be triggered after a note finishes (2026-07-31). The help URL was confirmed through search results and returned the expected title when fetched. No media source was read. 评审修正（2026-11-25）：官方名字「AI Meeting Notes」在卡片上认不出属于谁，与账本里「Notion AI」的记法保持一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.notion.com/releases/2025-05-13
